features.description: Owner spec (bug list): the WebMCP builder should be a wizard, not an input page. Step 1: the user gives an exact description of what the tool should do (vague or granular). Step 2: an AI digests it, asks clarifying questions, and reasons in a scratchpad WITHOUT writing code: a proposed tool list (name, one-job purpose, inputs, persona/category). Step 3: the user approves or edits the list. Step 4: only then the agent emits the JSON spec following the existing exporter's schema and best practices: 5-10 tools per server, one tool one job, unused tools cut, tools split by persona or category. Escape hatch: a 'write your own JSON' mode where the agent only proofreads and reports problems. Build it as a stepper inside the existing /webmcp builder with server-side routes for digest (questions + proposal), and emit; the model call goes through the existing cliComplete/provider seam and honours the selected provider (never a silent fallback).
